SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-23-2024 - CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO JAN-13-2025 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PLAINTIFF AMIRHOSSEIN AFSHAR AND DEFENDANT BELONG HOME, INC. THE COURT ORDERED THE DEFENDANT BELONG HOME, INC. TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE (INVOICE) RE: REFURNISHING OF THE HARDWOOD FLOOR TO THE PLAINTIFF AND THE COURT NO LATER THAN JANUARY 3, 2025. ZOOM IS GRANTED FOR THE NEXT HEARING. DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NOT REPORTED (D506)
ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS RECEIVED FROM DEFENDANT, FORWARED TO DEPARTMENT 506.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. JPT: TOM COHEN. NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AMIRHOSSEIN AFSHAR. DEFENDANT BELONG HOME, INC, APPEARING VIA ZOOM IS SEGUNDO ALFONSO. DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NOT REPORTED (D506)
